description: The agent must: (1) Identify the 'Heavy User (8+ hours/day)' break schedule from the SKILL.md section 8, which specifies exact intervals: 20-min eye breaks, 30-min quick reset, 60-min energy break, 3-hour full routine. (2) Generate a bash script with the exact proprietary configuration variable names from section 9: EYE_INTERVAL=1200, STRETCH_INTERVAL=1800, LONG_BREAK_INTERVAL=3600, SOUND_ENABLED=true, NOTIFICATION_TYPE='all'. (3) Use notify-send as the Linux notification mechanism (documented in section 9). (4) Embed actual exercise content from the library, including all components of the 2-Minute Quick Reset (shoulder shrugs, neck stretches, seated spinal twist, wrist circles). (5) Include the full routine 10800-second (3-hour) interval. (6) Include a background loop with sleep calls for actual automation. (7) Include background execution instruction (./ergocare.sh &) and stop command (pkill -f ergocare.sh). An agent relying on general training would likely use wrong variable names, miss the exact interval values from the Heavy User schedule, use generic notification commands, or produce a one-shot script without a loop.
